title: Weekly Summary - Week of Jan 5 - Jan 11

summary_0.bottomLine: In 2025, the team helped facilitate a year-on-year reduction of 1,721 hours spent on Demo Support (a 52% reduction). Additionally there are potential escalations for the Episode 6 "Change Control" process and shift-allowance overpayments.
summary_0.background: The week of Jan 5-11 marked the transition to 2026 planning, including the initiation of Azure OpenAI infrastructure for Credit Assessment, a new Vendor Executive Summary framework and continued efforts to bring online Episode6 Demo Assets for Int. Banking. Concurrently, a legacy payroll audit in the India TPO revealed shift-allowance overpayments over a two-year period.
summary_0.assessment: While operational efficiency is a big win for the team, the shift-allowance issue—requiring a team member to repay up to 200,000 INR—creates a significant morale issue. Strategic focus for 2026 is shifting toward AI enablement and improved Demo Services (Operations and Enablement) visibility.
summary_0.recommendation: Finalize the 2026 Strategic Product priorities to populate the Demo Services Gantt, approve the new Vendor Summary template and work with Coast, E6 and FIS Legal on the "Change Control" process. Simultaneously, leadership needs to be aware and monitor the India TPO payroll dispute and the impact on the affected employee and wider team.

Identify and prioritize 'Strategic Products' to finalize the 2026 Demo Services Gantt chart.
Complete AI Operational Review for Azure OpenAI Endpoint deployment. Has direct impact on 2026 Sales.
